requirements.meaning: Observation, measurement, units, uncertainty and simple experimental reasoning
requirements.evidence: Accepted C01 measurement/metrology curriculum: physical quantities, SI units, instruments, calibration, uncertainty and experimental reasoning.

requirements.meaning: Motion, forces, mass versus weight, energy, momentum and core mechanics
requirements.evidence: Accepted C02 mechanics plus reconciled repair. Mass is Newtonian inertial scalar in kg and not force; weight is gravitational force in N, local-field dependent; W=m g only in the stated local approximately uniform-field model; apparent weight is distinct.

requirements.meaning: Matter states, density/pressure and particle-model physical meaning at physics ownership boundary
requirements.evidence: C03 covers solids/liquids/gases and continuum properties; C04 covers thermal/statistical particle meaning and phase change; C08 covers atoms/molecules. Chemistry-specific composition/reaction ownership is excluded.

requirements.meaning: Temperature, heat, energy transfer, internal energy and basic thermodynamics
requirements.evidence: Accepted C04 progression explicitly secures temperature/heat, first law/internal energy, entropy/second law, equilibrium and familiar phase changes before advanced statistical/non-equilibrium extensions.

requirements.meaning: Waves, sound, light and basic optics
requirements.evidence: Accepted C05 covers amplitude/wavelength/frequency, wave propagation, interference/diffraction, acoustics, geometrical and wave optics, with foundational meanings repaired before laser/photonics extensions.

requirements.meaning: Electric charge, current, circuits, magnetism and electromagnetic phenomena
requirements.evidence: Accepted C06 covers charge/electric field, current, magnetism, induction, circuits and EM waves; Director repair secured basic magnet behavior, current-carrying conductor force and closed-path/source-load/node-branch circuit literacy.

requirements.meaning: Atomic, nuclear and radiation foundations at general-education depth
requirements.evidence: C08 secures atom/molecule/spectroscopy foundations; C10 secures nucleus, radioactivity, nuclear reactions and particle-physics extensions, with foundational nuclear sequence preceding advanced Standard Model/accelerator/plasma material.

requirements.meaning: Scientific modelling, evidence, assumptions, limits and quantitative reasoning across physical phenomena
requirements.evidence: Across accepted child objectives and closures, D1-D4 progression includes observation, model construction, formalization, evidence/assumption checks and model-limit critique; all support resolves to accepted/local claims.

requirements.meaning: Applied energy, devices, sensors and interdisciplinary physical-principle contexts
requirements.evidence: Accepted C12 covers computational/applied interfaces, energy, devices and sensors while restricting domain conclusions to physics-owned measurement/model principles.

requirements.meaning: Earth/space, biological and medical domain conclusions beyond the underlying physical principle
requirements.owner_scope: B1.4 for Earth/space; biological/medical domain owner is outside the canonical B1 scope map and is not asserted by this audit
requirements.evidence: B1.2 supplies transferable mechanics, thermodynamics, EM, radiation and sensing principles. Canonical B1 assigns Earth/space domain conclusions to B1.4; biological and medical domain conclusions are outside B1.2 and are not reassigned to B1.3 chemistry or B1.5 information/computation. Exact non-B1 owner is intentionally not asserted here.
